name: Modern Chemistry
tagline: Contemporary advances redefining how we think about matter and reactions.
seo_title: Modern Chemistry — paper summaries, news & innovations | Chemisters
seo_description: Follow Chemisters Modern Chemistry on LinkedIn and Facebook: paper summaries, news and innovations at the frontiers of modern chemistry.

definition.lead: Modern Chemistry follows the advances of recent decades that are changing how chemists think and work: new reactions, new tools, new materials and new ways of discovering.
definition.body: Click chemistry, organocatalysis, photoredox catalysis, cryo-EM, AI structure prediction, metal–organic frameworks and self-driving labs were not in textbooks a generation ago. This page tracks the ideas reshaping chemistry right now.

timeline.title: Fullerenes
timeline.why: A new form of carbon opened nanochemistry.

timeline.title: MOF-5
timeline.text: Omar Yaghi's group reports a landmark porous framework.
timeline.why: Started the boom in designed porous materials.

timeline.title: Organocatalysis returns
timeline.text: Benjamin List and David MacMillan independently report asymmetric organocatalysis.
timeline.why: A third pillar of catalysis beside metals and enzymes.

timeline.title: Click chemistry
timeline.text: Sharpless and colleagues define click chemistry.
timeline.why: Changed how molecules are linked together.

timeline.title: Photoredox in synthesis
timeline.text: Visible-light photoredox catalysis enters mainstream organic synthesis.

timeline.title: CRISPR
timeline.text: Charpentier and Doudna show that Cas9 can be programmed to cut DNA.
timeline.why: Chemistry and biology gained a precise editing tool.

timeline.title: Cryo-EM
timeline.why: Structures of molecules that cannot be crystallized.

timeline.title: AlphaFold 2
timeline.text: AI predicts protein structures with near-experimental accuracy.

timeline.title: MOFs win the Nobel Prize
timeline.text: Kitagawa, Robson and Yaghi are honoured.
